scenarios.name: Local reference checks
scenarios.acceptance: Exact adaptive and address vectors match; module boundaries pass
scenarios.dependency: Runnable in current worktree

scenarios.name: Local component tests
scenarios.acceptance: Adaptive, address, and persistent record suites execute with zero failures
scenarios.dependency: Runnable in current worktree

scenarios.name: Release baseline
scenarios.acceptance: All required workspace, feature, platform, client, crypto vector, and interoperability checks pass on exact candidate; binaries match provenance
scenarios.dependency: Release failures and candidate definition

scenarios.name: Genesis ceremony
scenarios.acceptance: A clean CI runner and a fresh container reproduce the genesis digest, approved allocations, stake and initial state (the acceptance profile); changed inputs fail startup
scenarios.dependency: The spendable rehearsal genesis (T1); for production, the final input freeze records

scenarios.name: Cold network launch
scenarios.acceptance: Empty nodes start from the same bundle and agree on first finalized checkpoint; late starts synchronize
scenarios.dependency: Distributed consensus and peer synchronization

scenarios.name: Client transactions
scenarios.acceptance: SDK and wallet submit valid transfers through public interfaces; balances, fees, nonces, and receipts match an independent reference
scenarios.dependency: Client format and account authorization

scenarios.name: Account key lifecycle
scenarios.acceptance: Creation, authorized rotation, recovery, and restart preserve account identity and balances; obsolete keys cannot authorize later writes
scenarios.dependency: Atomic account authorization and rotation

scenarios.name: Adaptive economics
scenarios.acceptance: Selected corrected adaptive controller, approved 40/30/30 reward allocation, issuance, fees, burns, and supply reconcile at every transition; reference vectors cover boundaries and unavailable observations
scenarios.dependency: D01 specification and qualification, site curve reconciliation, approved parameters, and atomic economic integration

scenarios.name: Validator lifecycle
scenarios.acceptance: Delegation, rewards, residuals, unbonding, validator changes, and specified slashing preserve accounting and finality rules
scenarios.dependency: Approved stake lifecycle

scenarios.name: Contract and governance lifecycle
scenarios.acceptance: Required initial governance and treasury controls pass proposal, vote, outcome execution, authorization, persistence, and upgrade checks; every enabled contract module passes its lifecycle checks
scenarios.dependency: Required initial governance implementation and approved authority/parameter rules; approved optional contract boundary

scenarios.name: Node outage and rejoin
scenarios.acceptance: Planned process and host loss preserve finalized history; restarted nodes catch up within approved recovery target
scenarios.dependency: Distributed harness and recovery target

scenarios.name: Network interruption and restoration
scenarios.acceptance: Controlled isolation and delay preserve safety; normal progress resumes under the approved synchrony and stake assumptions
scenarios.dependency: Consensus fault model and isolated network harness

scenarios.name: Consensus fault-model qualification
scenarios.acceptance: Hashlock's audit and the public review cover the approved fault assumption (less than one third faulty; with one validator, none tolerated); no conflicting finalization in any run
scenarios.dependency: The audit of the frozen candidate

scenarios.name: Storage recovery
scenarios.acceptance: Controlled interruption at commit boundaries, full storage, backup restoration, and snapshot synchronization preserve finalized state
scenarios.dependency: Distributed persistence integration and recovery procedures

scenarios.name: Upgrade and abort
scenarios.acceptance: Supported mixed-version period and activation preserve state; pre-activation abort succeeds; post-finality recovery follows the approved protocol
scenarios.dependency: Version compatibility and recovery rules

scenarios.name: Capacity and sustained load
scenarios.acceptance: Specified workload meets approved finality and throughput targets; queue, disk, memory, and CPU stay within declared limits
scenarios.dependency: Distributed candidate and launch demand forecast

scenarios.name: Operator response
scenarios.acceptance: Monitoring detects every injected service failure and resolves after recovery; the operator executes restore, validator recovery and root control procedures within the approved targets
scenarios.dependency: The real alerting and uptime services, the staging agent (T2), the rehearsal kits and the runbooks

scenarios.name: Repeated full launch
scenarios.acceptance: Seven fresh full launch runs R01-R07 pass on the final candidate, after the audit fixes, on the production hosts before genesis, with the production architecture, token model, validator model, genesis, deployment, upgrade procedures and runbooks
scenarios.dependency: L03-L17 and the simulation tools T1-T9

scenarios.name: Frozen-candidate qualification
scenarios.acceptance: Recorded frozen candidate passes all seven full-run operating periods, including R07 checkpoints from T-6h through T+24h; no unapproved configuration shortcuts
scenarios.dependency: R01-R07 evidence and approved workload, finality, recovery, and operating-period criteria

scenarios.name: Final launch decision
scenarios.acceptance: All mandatory evidence passes; Hashlock's report is published and its findings fixed or answered; release and genesis digests agree; three of the five genesis keys sign and the founder signs off
scenarios.dependency: All earlier scenarios and G0-G8 gate evidence

allocation_policy.emission_controller: D01 selected corrected adaptive controller; not the website piecewise-linear curve
allocation_policy.emission_conflict_status: blocker before protocol freeze; allocation approval does not replace D01

superseded_proposals: Three complete fresh launches: replaced by seven mandatory Week 4 runs.
At least 30 consecutive days: not an approved mandatory launch requirement. Retained only in archived prior text.

Four independent operators, three failure domains, two restore/upgrade exercises, twice forecast peak and 99.9% normal-load finality: replaced by the solo launch profile and the approved thresholds (simulation plan approval).
Week 4 placement of the seven runs: replaced by task-driven placement after the audit fixes, on the final candidate.

approved_thresholds.integrity: Zero conflicting finalized blocks; the same app hash on every node at every checkpoint; exact supply reconciliation; no committed block lost in any recovery. A failure stops the run.
approved_thresholds.liveness: Outside injected faults, median block interval at most 6 s and 99th percentile at most 10 s.
approved_thresholds.inclusion: At half capacity, 99% of valid transactions committed within 2 blocks; at full capacity, no valid transaction lost.
approved_thresholds.recovery: Validator restart 5 minutes; network heal 2 minutes; sentry or endpoint rebuilt 4 hours; validator host 8 hours; every injected fault alerts and resolves.
approved_thresholds.load: R06: full capacity (about 180 basic Sends a block) for 1 hour and half capacity for 6 hours, across 1,000 wallets.
approved_thresholds.timings: R01-R06 use a recorded set of shortened timings so each lifecycle completes inside its run; R07 uses the exact production values.
